text: {"lessons":["I should judge each stock by its prospects and the whole portfolio, not by whether it is above or below my purchase price.","Selling winners felt satisfying, but taking gains too quickly can leave me out of further upside; I should use a consistent plan rather than the pleasure of locking in a profit.","After buying Stock C at a higher price, I held through declines. I should reassess the investment with current information instead of avoiding a sale just because admitting a mistake feels painful."]}
